R6Generator <- R6::R6Class("MutationR6", lock_class = TRUE,
  public = list(value = 2, read = function(before = 1) self$value * before),
  active = list(doubled = function(value) {
    if (missing(value)) self$value * 2 else self$value <- value / 2
  }))
old <- R6Generator$new()
locked_error <- inherits(try(R6Generator$set("public", "blocked", 1), silent = TRUE), "try-error")
R6Generator$unlock()
Alias <- R6Generator
Alias$set("public", "read", function(after = 3) self$value * after, overwrite = TRUE)
Alias$set("private", "secret", function(scale = 4) scale)
Alias$set("public", "added", NULL)
Alias$set("public", "clone", function(other) other, overwrite = TRUE)
R6Generator$lock()
fresh <- R6Generator$new()
fresh$doubled <- 10

ReferenceGenerator <- methods::setRefClass("MutationReference",
  fields = list(value = "numeric", doubled = function(new_value) {
    if (missing(new_value)) value * 2 else value <<- new_value / 2
  }), methods = list(read = function(before = 1) value * before,
                    removed = function() 1))
reference_old <- ReferenceGenerator(value = 2)
reference_cached <- ReferenceGenerator(value = 2)
cached <- reference_cached$read
ReferenceAlias <- ReferenceGenerator
ReferenceAlias$methods(read = function(after = 3) value * after,
                       added = function(scale = 4) value * scale)
ReferenceGenerator$methods(removed = NULL)
ReferenceGenerator$lock("value")
ReferenceGenerator$methods(after_lock = function() value)
reference_fresh <- ReferenceGenerator(value = 2)
field_lock_error <- inherits(try(reference_fresh$value <- 3, silent = TRUE), "try-error")
GlobalLockedGenerator <- methods::setRefClass("MutationLockedGlobal", where = globalenv())
lockBinding(".__C__MutationLockedGlobal", globalenv())
class_lock_error <- inherits(try(GlobalLockedGenerator$methods(blocked = function() 1), silent = TRUE), "try-error")
observer:
owner <- environment()
r6_members <- c(as.list(setNames(rep("field", length(R6Generator$public_fields)),
                                names(R6Generator$public_fields))),
                as.list(setNames(rep("method", length(R6Generator$public_methods)),
                                names(R6Generator$public_methods))),
                as.list(setNames(rep("active-binding", length(R6Generator$active)),
                                names(R6Generator$active))))
reference_methods <- grep("#", ReferenceGenerator$methods(), invert = TRUE, value = TRUE)
facts <- list(
  system = "member_mutations",
  classes = list(
    list(name = "MutationR6", binding = "R6Generator", parents = list(), members = r6_members),
    list(name = "MutationReference", binding = "ReferenceGenerator", parents = list(),
         members = c(list(value = "field", doubled = "active-binding"),
                     as.list(setNames(rep("method", length(reference_methods)), reference_methods))))
  ),
  constructors = list(list(binding = "R6Generator$new", formals = formal_facts(R6Generator$new)),
                      list(binding = "ReferenceGenerator", formals = formal_facts(ReferenceGenerator))),
  methods = list(method_facts("read", "old", old$read, owner),
                 method_facts("read", "fresh", fresh$read, owner),
                 method_facts("read", "reference_old", reference_old$read, owner),
                 method_facts("read", "reference_cached", reference_cached$read, owner),
                 method_facts("clone", "fresh", fresh$clone, owner),
                 method_facts("read", "reference_fresh", reference_fresh$read, owner)),
  dispatch = list(dispatch_facts("old$read()", old, owner),
                  dispatch_facts("fresh$read()", fresh, owner),
                  dispatch_facts("fresh$doubled", fresh, owner),
                  dispatch_facts("reference_old$read()", reference_old, owner),
                  dispatch_facts("reference_cached$read()", reference_cached, owner),
                  dispatch_facts("reference_fresh$read()", reference_fresh, owner),
                  dispatch_facts("locked_error", fresh, owner),
                  dispatch_facts("field_lock_error", reference_fresh, owner),
                  dispatch_facts("class_lock_error", reference_fresh, owner))
)
